title: Faith Hedgepeth Trial: The Note, the DNA and 14 Years of Waiting

lines.say: In September 2012, a nineteen-year-old student at the University of North Carolina was found dead in an apartment in Chapel Hill.

lines.say: On the bed near her, police found a note, written on a fast-food bag.

lines.say: It said, "I'm not stupid." And then, "Jealous." Police believed her killer wrote it.
